Try your hand at the "Butterfly Survey," part of the Environment Ministry's Monitoring Sites 1000 (里地調査) program.

【Fee】Adults ¥2,000 / Elementary school children and younger ¥500 (includes guide and insurance)

【Capacity】10 people

【Guide】Osamu Oishi, Hanno Natural Science Research Institute

【What to bring】Insect net, binoculars (if you have them), writing materials, drinking water
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館内（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」下車徒歩3分）
